shared_elements: carved script signs / hieroglyph-like symbols arranged in rows
rectangular slab/stela format with relief carving
justification: Both surfaces are inscribed slabs bearing rows of small pictorial script signs, some containing human heads, which is the only real correspondence. But A is entirely a dense grid of blocky glyph blocks with no figural scene, whereas B is dominated by full-length standing human figures in profile facing one another with only a short line of signs above them, so the depicted content and organisation differ fundamentally.
